checks.name: Delivered0.61 reproduces stationary-pivot full-circle tilt instead of yaw in both directions
Adjacent40px stationary pivots recognize a complete circle in either direction and with either finger stationary in all three modes
Normal and wide stationary pivots keep yaw through full circles without producing pitch, translation or zoom
A nearly anchored finger and strongly unequal opposing arcs remain rotation rather than midpoint tilt
Adjacent equal and unequal opposing vertical strokes recognize angular intent in both directions
Continuous diametric and stationary two-circle strokes accumulate beyond360deg with no angular ceiling
A long pivot reverses while the same pointers remain active and releases the previous yaw direction
True parallel vertical travel and modest unequal parallel travel retain native tilt, with no yaw or pinch
Delivered0.61 loses fractional slow tilt; the current adapter retains that travel until a real pitch step
Parallel horizontal two-finger travel remains native pan and never becomes rotation
Radial pinch remains zoom with both fingers moving or one fixed, expanding and contracting
Lifting the moving pivot finger fences its stationary partner until all up, then a new opposite stroke works
Native menu fences block pivot rotation and release an existing pivot without replay after return
One-finger pan, yaw pulse timing and release/fence functions retain their exact delivered0.61 bodies
